text: When did the pain start and did it come on suddenly or gradually?
Does the pain move anywhere else, and how would you rate it on a scale of 1 to 10?
Have you vomited, and if so was there any blood in it?
Have you been having any heartburn or indigestion lately?
Do you take aspirin or other painkillers regularly?
Have your stools been black or tarry looking at all?
Have you noticed any melena or hematemesis?
Do you take NSAIDs on a regular basis?
Is this pain more like a dyspeptic burning or true peritonitic sharp pain?
Have you ever had gallstones or been told you have gallbladder problems?
Do you have any allergies to medications?
Has anyone in your family had stomach ulcers or stomach cancer?
Is there anything else about the pain or how you're feeling that you think I should know?
expect: open ended, patient may give minimal answer

text: Tell me more about how this whole thing started last night.
Anything else going on with your health recently that we haven't talked about?
expect: open ended, may mention driving, back pain, ibuprofen

text: What did the vomit look like, and was there any blood or coffee-ground material in it?
Do you take ibuprofen or anti-inflammatory medicines, and how often?
Have you had burning stomach pain before, and do you take anything for it regularly?
You said the pain was right in the middle at first, but now you say it hurts everywhere - can you clarify that for me?
expect: clarification, started center, now diffuse/all over

text: You mentioned the pain goes through to your back - how sure are you that it's not just spreading from the front?
Earlier you said nothing makes the pain better - is staying still helping even a little?
expect: keeping still helps a little, movement worse
